name: Norlevorphanol
summary: Norlevorphanol is an opioid analgesic of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It is the levo-isomer of 3-hydroxymorphinan (morphinan-3-ol). Norlevorphanol is a Schedule I Narcotic controlled substance in the United States with an ACSCN of 9634 and in 2014 it had an annual aggregate manufacturing quota of 52 grams.870). It has morphine-like pharmacological properties.

uses.text: Norlevorphanol is an opioid analgesic of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It is used as the hydrobromide (free base conversion ratio 0.750) and hydrochloride (0.870).

summaryZh: 去甲左啡諾（英語：norlevorphanol）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C16H21NO，屬於嗎啡喃類阿片鎮痛藥，從未上市銷售。
summaryZhHans: 去甲左啡诺（英语：norlevorphanol）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C16H21NO，属于吗啡喃类阿片镇痛药，从未上市销售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: The morphinans are morphine stripped of one of its oxygen-containing rings, a simplification found in the 1940s that led to medicines such as levorphanol and the cough suppressant dextromethorphan.
fact.zh: 嗎啡喃類是去掉嗎啡其中一個含氧環的簡化結構，這項在 1940 年代發現的簡化，催生了左旋嗎啡喃與鎮咳藥右美沙芬等藥物。
fact.zhHans: 吗啡喃类是去掉吗啡其中一个含氧环的简化结构，这项在 1940 年代发现的简化，催生了左旋吗啡喃与镇咳药右美沙芬等药物。
